dedup.scope: Targeted neighbours only: every public item whose record mentions this DOI, twistor spaces, almost complex structures on six-manifolds, self-intersection numbers or Chern-class pairings, plus the retired-claims list and the preparation worklist, and the same-source counted unit. No global novelty claim.
compared: public 1307 (same source, counted unit): Theorem 4.4 with label Qhomotopy6, statement source lines 822-823, proofs at 201-217, 301-327, 794-799 and 803-821. It computes the rational minimal model of a component of the space of almost complex structures; it contains no intersection number and no Chern-class pairing, and none of its counted spans touches this task's spans (995-996, 998-999, 405-419, 839-846, 942-972, 974-983).

public 108387 'Geometry of the Space of Sections of Twistor Spaces with Circle Action' (arxiv:2102.10853v3, claim prop-energyc-fixed-sections): a property of fixed sections of a twistor space under a circle action, proved by a different equivariant argument. It has no pair of twistor sections and no intersection-number formula.

public 191480 'Secondary cohomology operations and sectional category' (arxiv:2512.19461v2, label lem:Mwgttwistor): computes the sectional category of the twistor bundle. Same total space, entirely different invariant; no Chern classes of an almost complex structure appear.

public 192938 'On a Modification of the Twistor Space' (arxiv:2601.12372v1, corollary): a modification construction on twistor space with its own adjacent proof; different object and different conclusion.

public 1769 (doi:10.3842/SIGMA.2018.034, label cor;noStrongJ): rules out almost complex structures on the round six-sphere satisfying a connection condition by a cohomological contradiction. It is a nonexistence statement about one almost complex structure, not an intersection formula for two of them.

public 808 and public 169270 (twistor CR manifolds, Fefferman metric): the word twistor refers to the CR/twistor correspondence over a conformal three-manifold; the objects, the dimension and the conclusion are unrelated.
